people.name: Mr. Sunil Vachani
people.evidence_quote: Re-appointment of Mr. Sunil Vachani (DIN: 00025431) as the Whole Time Director of the Company for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years with effect from 5th May, 2027 along with his remuneration, liable to retire by rotation
people.tenure_quote: for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years
people.bio_quote: Mr. Sunil Vachani has over three decades of experience in the EMS industry. He is associated with the Company since its inception and under his reins, the Company has been adjudged as one of the leading Indian EMS by various trade journals and industry bodies.

people.name: Mr. Atul B. Lall
people.evidence_quote: Re-appointment of Mr. Atul B. Lall (DIN: 00781436) as Managing Director of the Company for a period of 5 (five) consecutive years with effect from 5th May, 2027 along with his remuneration, liable to retire by rotation.
people.tenure_quote: for a period of 5 (five) consecutive years
people.bio_quote: Mr. Atul B. Lall has been leading Dixon Technologies (India) Limited since foundation and built it to its current leadership position in the EMS Industry. He is responsible for Dixon’s overall strategy and business operations.
